text_block_list.text:
We've been gathering members, and the
team is
really starting to take shape.
One day...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Trainer! I've got the world's best

suggestion, and I hope you like it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I used my noggin to think of the best
way to
power up our ol' team!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
To give ourselves a team name! We
gotta come
up with a cheerful-soundin'
name that anyone'll
love!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I don't got any ideas right now, but I'll
let ya
know as soon as I do!

Taiki Shuttle dashes off as quickly as she
came...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I thought up a name! I think this one'll
really
represent how fun and friendly we
are!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We should call ourselves... "Happy
Hoppers"!
Hehe. Not bad, right?

That might be a good team name! I'll
have to
make note of it.
